rows.10:dfb8:
Aizawa was beaten like a punching bag.
Beaten and battered, Aizawa screamed,
"I'm sorry, but I just had to know.
If a person falls off a roof, do they die, or what happens?"
That was the reason he gave, I'm told.
And then Kuwahata,{p}
rows.10:ee34:
The next day, the bodies of Aizawa and Kuwahata were found in the schoolyard.
There was no suicide note, and no connection between the two was ever found, so the case went cold...
But afterwards, something strange happened.
When summer vacation ended that year, the science teacher was looking over the students' independent research reports, and found one submitted jointly by Aizawa and Kuwahata, even though they had died before the break.
It had this title:
"On Throwing Oneself from the Roof"
Its contents were roughly what I've just told you.{p}
rows.10:f4e8:
The next day at school, he still heard nothing about Kuwahata.
And even after another week had passed, no one knew where Kuwahata was.
In the end, the police and the school wrote Kuwahata off as a runaway.
Kuwahata had always had behavior problems, so no one looked too deeply into the cause.
(Did the teachers cover it up because they were afraid of a scandal...?)
He even entertained such a convenient idea.
So, to make sure that Kuwahata was dead, Aizawa decided to continue the experiment.{p}
rows.10:1224c:
As {f:my|my} consciousness faded, the face of the person I had met at the seven wonders storytelling that day came into view.
His name was, if I remember right... Arai...
"Now, the time has come for you to set off on your journey too.
Let's go together.
Look... Aizawa is here too..."
Over Arai's shoulder floated a huge skull.
I shouldn't have stopped the seven wonders meeting partway through.
I shouldn't have poked my nose into this school's supernatural phenomena so half-heartedly{f:...|...}
{f:I would probably|I was going to} become material for Aizawa's experiment{f:.|.}
Arai was grinning.
There was no escape.
No escape from this reality.
Would the last thing {f:I|I} saw be the sky{f:,|,} or blood splattered across the ground{f:?|?}
That, I would soon find out{f:.|.}{p}
